claim: The FineWeb-Edu classifier is a Snowflake-arctic-embed-m encoder with a single regression head trained on 450k Llama3-70B-instruct educational-quality annotations scored 0-5, with the embedding and encoder layers frozen during training.
stance_target: The repo's data-pipeline claim that its 9B-token corpus is FineWeb-Edu filtered
scope_conditions: HuggingFaceTB/fineweb-edu-classifier; 450,000 samples from FineWeb; 20 epochs at LR 3e-4
quoted_support: We added a classification head with a single regression output to Snowflake-arctic-embed and trained the model for 20 epochs with a learning rate of 3e-4. During training, the embedding and encoder layers were frozen to focus on the classification head.

claim: As a binary classifier at score threshold 3 the filter reaches F1 82% and accuracy 0.71 on a 46,867-sample hold-out, which is the quality ceiling of the filter the repo's corpus depends on.
stance_target: How much of the repo's data-quality claim rests on a classifier with a measurable error rate
scope_conditions: Hold-out set of 46,867 Llama3-annotated samples; binary threshold at score 3
quoted_support: The model achieved an F1 score of 82% when converted to a binary classifier using a score threshold of 3.

claim: The classifier's recall collapses at the top of the educational-quality scale (class 5 recall 0.01, class 4 recall 0.35), so the highest-quality tier is systematically under-selected by the filter.
stance_target: The assumption that a FineWeb-Edu-filtered corpus is enriched in the highest-quality educational content rather than merely excluding the worst
scope_conditions: Per-class classification report on the 46,867-sample hold-out

claim: The model card recommends int_score >= 3 as the curation threshold and warns the classifier is tuned to primary and grade-school educational content, so it may underperform on higher-education or specialised domains.
stance_target: Whether FineWeb-Edu filtering is appropriate for a technical/code-heavy pretraining mix
scope_conditions: Model card limitations section; out-of-distribution samples
quoted_support: It might overfit to academic looking content for the higher scores and we recommend int_score >= 3 as a threshold for data curation.
